expert.name: Mei
expert.quote: Mutianyu rather than Badaling is the right call. Same wall, a fraction of the crowd and a far better walk.
expert.tip: Take the cable car up and walk down. The steps on the lower towers are punishing in the other direction.

summary: A two night stop with the one day that matters: the Great Wall at Mutianyu, the quietest of the restored sections, followed by the lake and long corridor of the Summer Palace.
